rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for entering marriage.

example.english: We plan to marry next year.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 nin4 daa2 syun3 git3 fan1

rows.note: Use 娶 when the subject is a man taking a woman as his wife.

example.english: Ming finally got to marry the girl he loves.
example.traditional: 阿明終於娶到佢心愛嘅女仔。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zung1 jyu1 ceoi2 dou2 keoi5 sam1 oi3 ge3 neoi5 zai2

rows.note: Use 嫁 when the subject is a woman marrying a man.

example.english: She decided to marry at twenty-five.
example.traditional: 佢二十五歲先決定嫁人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji6 sap6 ng5 seoi3 sin1 kyut3 ding6 gaa3 jan4

rows.note: Use 證婚 when an officiant performs or solemnizes the wedding ceremony.

example.english: The pastor will marry us tomorrow, so don’t worry.
example.traditional: 聽日由牧師幫我哋證婚，唔使擔心。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jau4 muk6 si1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zing3 fan1 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
